q: Store or bulk run: how do I sell?

Shop is your own store at merchfrom.com/you or your own domain. Each piece is printed as it sells: no stock, no minimums, no upfront cost. You set the retail price and keep everything above our base cost, paid with each sale. Zero upfront applies to Shop only.

Run is a bulk order for a tour, festival or studio, screen printed or embroidered, folded, tagged and shipped to you, to the venue, or split ahead of time across the cities on your tour. A run is paid before it goes to press, once you have approved the proof.
